page.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or its key changed. The task list shows the project's tasks.

runLine.queued: Queued · its run has not started
runLine.unreadableUnnumbered: Its latest run could not be read

controls.offline: The runner is not connected; the run's controls return once it is online.
controls.worktreeRemoved: Continue is unavailable: run #{{run}}'s worktree was removed, so its agent has nothing to continue from. Run again starts a new run.

refused.start: The runner didn't start the run
refused.pause: The runner didn't pause the run
refused.resume: The runner didn't resume the run
refused.continue: The runner didn't continue the run

notices.staleTitle: The task couldn't be read again; it shows as last read

blockedBy.one: The run neither starts nor goes on until {{tasks}} finishes.
blockedBy.other: The run neither starts nor goes on until {{tasks}} finish.

explanation.branch: Run #{{run}} starts from {{base}}, the checkout's branch, in a worktree of its own. Run #{{previous}} stays as it is.
explanation.head: Run #{{run}} starts from the checkout's HEAD, in a worktree of its own. Run #{{previous}} stays as it is.

remove.title: Remove the worktrees of run #{{run}}
remove.clean: Nothing in them is uncommitted; {{branch}} keeps their committed work.

notShared.title: Not shared · read-only
notShared.body: {{task}} stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}} on {{day}}. Its runs, conversation and memory stay readable; nothing changes it and no run starts. Share task uploads it to {{server}} with the next {{key}} number, and it becomes a shared task like any other.
notShared.locked: Edit, Start run and the organization pickers are unavailable while {{task}} is Not shared.

share.title: Share {{task}} on {{project}}?
share.goes: It goes to {{project}} on {{server}} as {{next}}, the next number, with its title, brief, criteria, status, priority and tags. Every member sees it.
share.goesNext: It goes to {{project}} on {{server}} with the next {{key}} number, with its title, brief, criteria, status, priority and tags. Every member sees it.
share.similar: Similar on {{project}}: {{key}} {{title}} · {{by}}. If it's the same work, keep {{task}} here.
share.tags: Tags match {{project}}'s by name; a link to a task that stays here is dropped.
share.stays: Runs, the conversation and memory stay on this computer; run branches keep their names, and the next run is named by the new key.

joined.note: Briefs, criteria and messages written before the join still say {{former}}; Orchester doesn't rewrite them. Searching {{former}} finds this task.
